name: Relationship Drama
description: Your personal life is spilling into your professional one. Everyone's watching.

chapters.title: The DM
chapters.description: Your partner found messages in your phone. Someone from the scene. Now they want answers.

choices.label: Come Clean
choices.description: Tell the truth. Whatever happens, happens.

choices.label: Deny Everything
choices.description: It was nothing. You can explain.

choices.label: Turn It Around
choices.description: Why are they going through your phone? That's the real problem.

chapters.title: The Fallout
chapters.description: They're hurt. You're hurt. The whole situation is messy. And somehow it's getting out to people in the scene.

choices.label: Fight For the Relationship
choices.description: You messed up. Make it right.

choices.label: Let It Go
choices.description: Maybe this needed to happen. Time to move on.

chapters.title: More Receipts
chapters.description: They found more messages. Your story doesn't hold up. Now they're threatening to expose everything publicly.

choices.label: Confess Everything
choices.description: Stop lying. Tell them everything before they tell the world.

choices.label: Keep Denying
choices.description: Maybe they're bluffing. Hold the line.

chapters.title: Toxic Pattern
chapters.description: Arguments every night. You can't focus on prep. This relationship is poison for your career.

choices.label: End It Clean
choices.description: This isn't working. Walk away while you can.

choices.label: Suggest Counseling
choices.description: Try to fix this the right way.

choices.label: Stay In It
choices.description: You love them. It's complicated. That's life.

chapters.title: Controlled Narrative
chapters.description: You came clean before they could expose you. The story's out there but it's your version.

choices.label: Address It in Battle
choices.description: Own it. Make it part of your story.

choices.label: Don't Mention It
choices.description: Keep it out of your battles. That's personal.

chapters.title: Exposed
chapters.description: They posted everything. Screenshots. Videos. Your name is trending for all the wrong reasons.

choices.label: Damage Control
choices.description: Put out a statement. Try to save your reputation.

choices.label: Go Dark
choices.description: Delete socials. Let it blow over.

endings.title: Working On It
endings.description: You're trying to make it work. It's not easy but you're committed.

endings.title: Single
endings.description: It's over. You're focusing on yourself and your career now.

endings.title: Toxic Love
endings.description: You stayed in a bad situation. It's affecting everything else in your life.

endings.title: Owned It
endings.description: You turned personal drama into bars. The culture respects that authenticity.

endings.title: Kept It Private
endings.description: You kept your personal life out of your battles. Some things aren't for the stage.

endings.title: Scandal
endings.description: Your name is associated with drama now. Every opponent will bring it up.

endings.title: Recovered
endings.description: You went dark and came back. The heat died down. People forgot. Almost.
